Test my subscribed device

Send a test to notifications enabled for your account on up to five devices.

Check delivery on your phone
  1. Open Notifications on your phone and enable notifications. Confirm this page shows a device for your account.
  2. Put KCMC Connect in the background. From another window or device, select Test my device above.
  3. Check that the push service accepts the test. Review any failure message before retrying.
  4. Check that the notification appears on your phone, then tap it to open KCMC Connect.
  5. To test turning notifications off, disable them on that phone. Reload this page and confirm the device count decreases.

Use Test my device to check delivery. A broadcast is not needed. Acceptance by the push service does not confirm that your phone displayed the notification.

Broadcast to subscribed devices

Send an update to everyone who has enabled notifications, up to 200 devices per send.

Wait 30 seconds between sends. Expired device registrations are removed automatically; other failed devices stay registered.
